caption:
Every broker call and square off is logged to the second.

When a limit triggers, KaatDo cancels every pending order and squares off every position at market. The account stays locked until close, and re-fires if trading activity reappears.

You do not have to guess what executed. KaatDo maintains a full audit log of every evaluation and broker call, alongside Telegram alerts, webhook and email notifications.
